scope: Inspect assets/index.android.bundle from each actual downloaded compiled APK ZIP. Searches UTF-8, UTF-16LE and JSON-escaped string representations. Checks literal inclusion of all 68 added routine IDs, creator-routine IDs, corrected reference URLs, new native UI strings, and the complete canonical exercise-ID/guide-key inventory. Exercise IDs and guide keys are checked separately but share the same canonical values; finding a key proves that the string occurs in the compiled asset, not that every guide field, mapping, description or form instruction is semantically correct. Package/signature/source provenance are inspected separately. Does not establish installation, device runtime behavior, OS permissions or external-link availability.

newNativeLabels: No plans match these filters. Try another training style, name or frequency.

fullCatalogLiteralObservation.explanation: The D6-/D7- catalog IDs are constructed by template strings at runtime; the native engine audit separately executes these plans. Literal absence alone does not imply a missing generated plan.
